defect_found_and_fixed.defect: uv sync failed: transformers 4.24.0 requires tokenizers >=0.11.1,<0.14, and no release in that range ships a CPython 3.12 wheel, so uv attempted a source build requiring a Rust toolchain that is absent on a clean machine.
defect_found_and_fixed.justification: The validated generation environment ran with no tokenizers package installed. Generation uses the slow BertTokenizer over the pinned vocab.txt and never constructs a fast tokenizer. The override reproduces the validated environment exactly rather than changing it.
defect_found_and_fixed.severity: SUBMISSION BLOCKING - the organizers' own `uv sync` step would fail
defect_found_and_fixed.verified: tokenizers_present false after the fix; generation output byte-identical to the pre-fix artifacts.

note: Two clean invocations of the packaged entry point produced byte-identical library and top-100, and both match the shipped artifacts exactly. This satisfies the challenge requirement of a fixed default seed producing identical output on repeated runs.
platform: RunPod, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (capability 8.9), Ubuntu 24.04, CUDA 12.8

scorer_equivalence.meaning: The shipped R-free evaluator reproduces the native R-backed evaluator exactly on BOTH platforms, across all eight APEX member arrays, the APEX ensemble and the ANIA arrays. No R installation is required to reproduce the submitted top-100.

shipped_repo_excludes: runtime/ (machine-specific bootstrapped scorer runtime; built by scripts/prepare_entry.py)
assets/prompt_model/ (315 MB; retrieved and hash-verified from Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17018363 by scripts/prepare_entry.py)
vendor/scorer_subproject assets (235 MB APEX/ANIA; retrieved and hash-verified from their published repositories by scripts/prepare_entry.py)
